parsed_output.observed_need: The packet establishes only that contracting authorities published bounded sets of contract and contract-award notices under CPV class 9261, with stated TOTAL_VALUE amounts (notice scope, EUR, including options and renewals) that vary across notices within each set. parsed_output.candidate_intervention_class: Investigation-stage inquiry into the nature and drivers of procurement activity classified under CPV 9261, prior to any product or intervention definition
parsed_output.hypothesis_statement: It is worth investigating why contracting authorities publishing notices under CPV class 9261 show varying published TOTAL_VALUE figures across contract and award notices, and whether an actor with buying authority in this space has needs that a bounded, further-evidenced set of observations could characterise -- noting that this packet establishes only the existence of such published notices and value variation, not any need, gap, dissatisfaction, or willingness to pay.
parsed_output.independence_status: Independence is UNKNOWN for 6 of 6 rows; this packet does not establish that its evidence is independent, and the count of rows is not a count of independent findings.

parsed_output.evidence_bound_reasoning_summary: Six rows from one source family (public_procurement, via TED eForms notices/eforms-contract-and-award) establish that bounded sets of CONTRACT_NOTICE and CONTRACT_AWARD_NOTICE notices under CPV class 9261 exist, and that their published TOTAL_VALUE figures (notice scope, EUR) differ within each set, with specific max-minus-min spreads reported (e.g. 15,658,679.12 across 3 notices; 235,017 across 2 notices; 86,827,200 across 6 notices). TOTAL_VALUE per BT-161 includes options and renewals and is not realised spend, a price, or willingness to pay. The existence of contracting authorities publishing notices supports BUYER_OR_BUDGET_EXISTENCE; the notices themselves support MARKET_ACTIVITY (transactional/tender activity under this classification); the stated values support ECONOMIC_VALUE (money moves in some bounded sense within this scope). Nothing in the packet describes a problem, recurrence by a single actor, dissatisfaction, competitive supply, distribution channels, regulatory drivers, or feasibility of any intervention. No claim about market size, demand, adoption, or product fit can be drawn.
